name: Amatsu Denzaburou
source:
A handsome, polite young swordsman at the Takemizu dojo, talked about as a genius. Half the girls in Fukagawa show up just to watch him.

[spoiler]Actually a yoriki of the North Magistrate's Office, and the real Kurotengu.[/spoiler]
